repositories.name: img2threejs
repositories.description: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.

paragraphs: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural Three.js model.
Quality-gated, animation-ready, and deliberately token-efficient — reconstruction-by-code, not photogrammetry, mesh extraction, or downloaded art packs.
Reference images reconstructed in code as animation-ready Three.js models, running live in the browser.
features: Scripts enforce, the model judges. The Python scripts handle validation, gating, spec authoring, PBR extraction, comparison-sheet packaging, and pipeline state. They never score visuals. The model's tokens go to one…

Zero dependencies, zero install churn. Every script is pure Python 3.10+ standard library. No pip, no PIL, no numpy, no Playwright. PNG read/write is done with struct and zlib. Nothing to install means nothing to debug…
Pass-gated generation. The code generator emits only the currently unlocked build pass. The model does not regenerate or re-read the entire model on every iteration — each step is small and scoped.

Fail fast, before codegen. A strict-quality gate blocks shallow specs before a single line of Three.js is generated, so you never spend tokens rendering a model that was underspecified from the start.
One image per review. Each pass is judged from exactly one packaged comparison sheet (reference beside render), not a scattering of screenshots.

whatItDoes.text: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural Three.js model.

requirements.text: Private environment plugin: needs a GitHub account with access to its repository and working Git credentials.
A cost ceiling — Stay at low effort and skip the presentation composer; I only need the evaluation render.

repositories.description: A durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi agents, built on Pi Durable

paragraphs: A durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi agents, built on Pi Durable.
Runs on your own machine or directly on your phone. No cloud VM.
features: Durable. Every model call, tool call, and subagent is stored as it happens. Restart the server mid-run, and the work continues.
Multiplayer. Share a live session with presence, a side chat Pi does not see, invites, and roles.
Made for phones. Push notifications, dictation, sharing into Pi from other apps, and a home-screen app.
PiP. An assistant that starts, follows, and reports on your other sessions, and watches GitHub for you.
Your models. Pi's own providers, sign-ins, skills, and prompt templates, with the model chosen per session.
